name: Source revision changes
question: Which scope changed between issued models?
grain: One proposed object change between two snapshots
separate_because: Change review needs before-and-after meaning beyond source row identifiers
merge_or_defer: Defer until correspondence is defensible; uncertain matches remain candidates
rationale: Useful at new-delivery comparisons. The user describes data as infrequently updated, so revision comparison should not outrank every recurring query by an assumed frequent-change cadence.

name: Space
question: Which spaces exist and what activities and services belong to them?
grain: One bounded or explicitly scheduled space occurrence
separate_because: Room identity and room fields support many tasks
merge_or_defer: Treat room as a space use; avoid classes per room function
rationale: Room-facing finishes and service traces need stable space references; area and enclosure require separate evidence.

name: Storey
question: What belongs to this building level and what does its elevation mean?
decision: Navigate and group work by level
grain: One named building level
separate_because: A common grouping dimension needs elevation semantics
merge_or_defer: Use associations for multi-level objects; distinguish finish and structural levels
rationale: Expected frequent grouping value; existing workflows do not yet settle alternative level conventions.

name: Functional zone membership
question: Which spaces form this department or service zone?
grain: One object membership in a named zone under a purpose
separate_because: Departments and service areas overlap beyond a place hierarchy
merge_or_defer: Use controlled purposes; specialize only when rules differ
rationale: May remove repeated manual grouping; regulated safety zones require stronger rules than generic membership.

name: Service access envelope
question: Can someone operate or remove this component in the required direction?
grain: One required envelope for an object and operation
separate_because: Operational clearance differs from physical shape
merge_or_defer: Start from supplied requirements; do not infer safe clearance from generic dimensions
rationale: Blocked panels and inaccessible valves cause rework; models may lack the clearance shape and its authority.

name: Spatial conflict candidates
question: Which objects might intersect this work area or clearance?
decision: Narrow precise geometry and human review
grain: One candidate pair or object-region hit for a named test
separate_because: Screening is an operation producing bounded results
merge_or_defer: Use bounds first and exact geometry selectively
rationale: Expected broad coordination value at scale; approximate overlap must never become a confirmed clash.

name: Door
question: Does this door configuration meet the intended opening function?
grain: One door occurrence with explicit leaf or assembly scope
separate_because: Operation and clear opening recur in practical tasks
merge_or_defer: Keep hardware linked; settle leaf versus assembly counting
rationale: The current door_schedule already answers the worked width/rating audit. Additional value concerns operation, opening scope and space relationships; these need new examples.

name: Window
question: Which glazed openings share size and performance requirements?
decision: Package glazing and review envelope inputs
grain: One window unit at an explicit unit or assembly scope
separate_because: Glazed openings have recurring dimensions and performance fields
merge_or_defer: Use roles for operability; evaluate curtain-wall panel grain separately
rationale: Expected glazing schedule value; current envelope workflow provides only a broad requirement.

name: Wall
question: Which walls separate this area and what construction is intended?
grain: One wall occurrence with identifiable faces and assembly
separate_because: Host identity connects construction to separate room-facing surfaces
merge_or_defer: Keep finishes on surfaces; do not assign one universal room to a wall
rationale: The finish scenario proves two faces of one wall must remain distinct; broader wall fields need validation.

name: Floor construction
question: Which floor construction and finishes are in scope?
grain: One floor construction occurrence at a declared scope
separate_because: Construction and finish installation have different quantities and ownership
merge_or_defer: Use a structural-role facet rather than duplicate slab identity
rationale: May reduce slab-versus-finish double counting; the flooring workflow has not settled construction boundaries.

name: Roof
question: How much roof surface needs each assembly and what remains unknown?
decision: Prepare takeoff with the correct basis
grain: One roof occurrence or explicitly partitioned construction scope
separate_because: Surface and projected areas need distinct names
merge_or_defer: Use assembly layers rather than classes per roofing product
rationale: The current roof_takeoff already separates net and projected areas. Construction/edge detail is an extension, not a reason to duplicate roof identity or selected measurements.

name: Stair
question: Which levels does this stair connect and what route dimensions are known?
grain: One stair assembly with optional flight detail
separate_because: A level connection is useful before every tread is modeled
merge_or_defer: Defer flight and landing records until an assessment needs their separate geometry
rationale: Recognizable circulation data helps review; a simple stair record cannot establish compliant egress.

name: Service penetration
question: Which openings need approval and a compatible firestop detail?
grain: One opening through a host with linked passing services
separate_because: Openings span trades and have independent approval work
merge_or_defer: Link firestop specifications; do not infer required ratings from host names
rationale: Expected rework and safety value; current coordination cases do not yet validate a penetration approval workflow.

name: Structural member
question: Which members share section and material and measurable lengths?
grain: One physical structural member at an explicit occurrence scope
separate_because: Beams columns and braces share section and axis data
merge_or_defer: Use member roles; do not treat physical geometry as an analysis model
rationale: Expected steel and timber schedule value; connection and analysis detail should follow proven needs.

name: Foundation
question: Which foundations need concrete and excavation scope at what elevation?
grain: One footing pile or foundation assembly at explicit countable scope
separate_because: Bearing and ground context exceed generic member length
merge_or_defer: Use roles for piles and caps until separate fields are justified
rationale: Expected quantity value; foundation volume and excavation volume cannot be treated as equivalent.

name: Reinforcement fabrication takeoff
question: Which bar shapes and counts are ready for fabrication by pour?
grain: One selected bar mark and shape within a fabrication scope
separate_because: Fabrication requires more readiness than concrete quantities
merge_or_defer: Defer until bar shapes and regional scheduling rules exist; do not infer bars from concrete geometry
rationale: Potential reinforcement-trade value but detailed source coverage and fabrication rules make this a poor early default.

name: Earthwork zone
question: Where do existing and proposed ground imply cut or fill?
grain: One named earthwork scope with existing and proposed surfaces
separate_because: Earthworks need two surface states rather than one object volume
merge_or_defer: Defer computed volumes until surface coverage and datum alignment are established
rationale: Expected civil value; the broad landscape workflow does not yet justify an earthworks calculation engine.

name: Finish surface
question: Which face needs which finish and how much net area?
decision: Order materials and assign finish work
grain: One distinct finish-bearing surface partition with optional space association
separate_because: The measured and specified unit is a face rather than its host
merge_or_defer: Allow unassigned spaces and surface partitions; tag paint tile and coverings
rationale: finish_schedule already represents distinct faces and unresolved spaces. Review its domain naming and surface partitions before adding another record with the same grain.

name: Ceiling
question: Which ceiling construction and elevation applies and where is access required?
grain: One ceiling construction occurrence with associated spaces and surfaces
separate_because: Ceiling datum and access differ from floor surface information
merge_or_defer: Use shared assemblies and surfaces; defer grid and hanger detail until needed
rationale: Expected reflected-ceiling coordination value; current workflows have not established tile-level requirements.

name: Room fitout schedule
question: What finishes fixtures and equipment are specified per room and what is missing?
grain: One room and fitout category with linked selected items
separate_because: Room review combines records without duplicating their identities
merge_or_defer: Keep a view; expected categories come from project requirements
rationale: Combines existing finish and asset concepts into a useful room view. Its incremental benefit is coordination and packaging, not a new physical-object identity.

name: Planting area
question: Which areas need which planting and soil preparation quantities?
grain: One bounded planting or soil-preparation area at a declared layer scope
separate_because: Area-based planting differs from individually tracked assets
merge_or_defer: Separate area and soil-layer quantities; avoid classes per species
rationale: Expected landscape-trade value; ecological outcomes require more than planting area and species labels.

name: Landscape asset
question: Which individual trees or furnishings need installation or care records?
decision: Count and hand over selected assets
grain: One individually tracked landscape occurrence
separate_because: Individual care can require identity beyond a planting polygon
merge_or_defer: Use roles initially; keep bulk planting area-based and defer botanical lifecycle detail
rationale: Useful when individual tracking is required; low-value identities for every planting would inflate the model.

name: Equipment and plant overview
question: Which plant items exist by system and what handover or connection data is missing?
decision: Navigate equipment and review common handover coverage
grain: One identified equipment occurrence in a cross-system overview
separate_because: A cross-system overview helps navigation without defining every machine through generic properties
merge_or_defer: Keep this a view; pump duty and air-handler performance need separate typed records when specific workflows justify them
rationale: component_schedule and asset_register already provide much of the inventory. A cross-system overview adds readable joins and gaps; it does not justify a generic duty model.

name: Air terminal
question: Which terminal serves each space at what design airflow?
decision: Coordinate terminal schedules and ceiling openings
grain: One air terminal occurrence serving a space or zone
separate_because: Room service and airflow exceed generic equipment naming
merge_or_defer: Use roles for diffusers and grilles; distinguish design and measured flow
rationale: Expected mechanical value; terminal proximity cannot prove connectivity or balanced airflow.

name: Sanitary fixture
question: Which fixtures are specified per space and what connections are required?
decision: Count and coordinate supply and waste scope
grain: One installed or scheduled sanitary fixture occurrence
separate_because: Toilets basins and showers share schedule and connection needs
merge_or_defer: Use a toilet role; add a subtype only for repeated distinct fields
rationale: Expected plumbing and interior value; fixture units and consumption require explicit rule or measurement bases.

name: Service route geometry and endpoints
question: Where does this service segment run and which endpoints have supported links?
decision: Reuse routing context across trade-specific schedules
grain: One physical service occurrence and its route representation
separate_because: Route and endpoint context is reusable without replacing discipline-specific records
merge_or_defer: Apply alongside duct and pipe records; trays need their own workflow before further specialization
rationale: Trace cases justify shared routing context; duct airflow and pipe service properties belong to concrete trade records rather than a universal service type.

name: Electrical distribution panel
question: Which panel supplies each circuit and what capacity and access information is known?
decision: Review supply schedules and isolation scope
grain: One panel or electrical board occurrence
separate_because: Circuits and supply characteristics justify a recurring electrical model
merge_or_defer: Start circuit detail as relationships; avoid classes per panel style
rationale: Expected electrical-specific value; phase and spare-capacity calculations need explicit conventions.

name: Lighting fixture
question: Which luminaires belong to each room and circuit and serve emergency lighting?
grain: One installed luminaire occurrence
separate_because: Count power and emergency role recur across electrical and interior tasks
merge_or_defer: Reference photometric files; defer illumination simulation
rationale: Expected schedule value; emergency role alone cannot prove emergency-lighting compliance.

name: Valve
question: Which valve controls this branch and can staff identify and reach it?
grain: One valve occurrence with a control or isolation role
separate_because: Operational role and normal position matter beyond a fitting count
merge_or_defer: Do not infer safe isolation from tags; defer actuator internals
rationale: Expected operating value; trustworthy isolation additionally requires complete topology and current state.

name: Drain inlet
question: Which areas discharge through each drain and what outlet data is known?
grain: One drain inlet with declared catchment references
separate_because: A drain links a surface catchment with a network
merge_or_defer: Keep catchments explicit; defer hydraulic inference until boundary conditions exist
rationale: Expected cross-trade value; the roof scenario covers areas and does not validate drainage logic.

name: Fire-protection terminal
question: Which heads or service outlets belong to each protection system and lack inspection data?
grain: One terminal occurrence with declared protection role
separate_because: Protection roles and inspection needs recur over project stages
merge_or_defer: Use explicit roles; defer coverage and hydraulic adequacy calculations
rationale: Expected fire-trade schedule value; missing terminals cannot establish absence or adequate coverage.

name: Service support assembly
question: Which supports carry routes and need attachment approval?
grain: One support or rack assembly carrying one or more services
separate_because: Supports span structure and services with independent installation scope
merge_or_defer: Begin with explicit supports; defer automatic layout and seismic detailing
rationale: Potential coordination value when detail exists; source coverage may make early support taxonomy expensive.

name: Construction assembly specification
question: Which layers and specifications define this construction and what remains unspecified?
decision: Reuse specifications and allocate material scope
grain: One versioned assembly specification with component ordering defined
separate_because: Shared specifications differ from installed occurrences and quantities
merge_or_defer: Avoid universal composition theory; add layers where takeoff or performance needs them
rationale: Roof grouping and carbon contributions need reusable specifications; layer ordering and measurement remain open.

name: Selected quantity takeoff
question: What quantity can I sum and which items remain unmeasured?
grain: One selected quantity per subject and basis within a scope
separate_because: Users need additive selected quantities rather than competing observations
merge_or_defer: Preserve observations; never sum overlapping assembly and part scope
rationale: Selected quantity observations and scopes already exist. Additional value is a readable coverage-aware view and documented additive grouping.

name: Trade work package
question: Which objects and activities are in this package and what prevents release?
decision: Assign and price explicit work scope
grain: One package within a project planning scenario
separate_because: Commercial scope may contain many objects and tasks without geometry
merge_or_defer: Keep scenarios explicit; avoid building a full scheduling system
rationale: work_packages already scopes the estimate example. Dependencies and release readiness should extend that contract once additional cases establish their meaning.

name: Procurement requirement
question: Which specified items must be ordered and what prevents ordering?
decision: Prepare order scope and resolve selections
grain: One required purchasable item or specification in a package and scenario
separate_because: Purchased grouping differs from occurrence and installed quantity
merge_or_defer: Separate requirement from order and shipment; supplier terms require external data
rationale: Expected contractor value; current scenarios do not provide prices lead times or delivery commitments.

name: Installation or delivery observation
question: What was delivered or installed against requirements and what supports that observation?
decision: Accept flag or clarify an item
grain: One dated observation of a subject against a declared stage
separate_because: Site observation differs from design intent and interpretation
merge_or_defer: Record observations first; defer capture apps and transaction systems
rationale: Door audits motivate this extension but current cases concern model evidence; delivery observations need independent field evidence.

name: Asset service requirements
question: What documentation access and service obligations belong to this item?
grain: One asset and versioned service requirement set
separate_because: Maintainability cuts across physical categories without duplicating identity
merge_or_defer: Apply a facet to existing objects; keep events in operational systems
rationale: Handover explicitly tracks unknown manuals and maintainability; extra warranty and service fields require validation.

name: Maintenance planning view
question: Which services are due and what access or shutdown constraints apply?
grain: One asset service task in a planning period and schedule version
separate_because: Service planning combines requirements dates and operating constraints
merge_or_defer: Defer due-date computation until history and authoritative intervals are connected
rationale: Valuable to facilities but static BIM is insufficient; handover does not justify a maintenance management system.

name: Material impact breakdown
question: What contributes to carbon results and how much scope lacks factors?
grain: One additive contribution and factor application in a scenario and life-cycle module
separate_because: Impact needs factor and module context beyond a material label
merge_or_defer: Retain exclusions and uncertainty; defer full ecological impact claims
rationale: impact_lines already carries additive contribution, factor and module context. Reuse it for breakdowns; independently prove aggregation and coverage additions.

name: Requirement assessment results
question: Which requirements passed failed or could not be assessed and why?
decision: Direct review to failures and missing evidence
grain: One subject against one versioned requirement in a scenario
separate_because: A result is an explainable decision rather than a boolean property
merge_or_defer: Use domain evaluators later; avoid a universal executable rule language now
rationale: assessments already represents this row grain, result and incomplete inputs. Reuse its result view; a second independent assessment record adds little. This does not devalue safety work.

name: Model evidence issues
question: Which missing or conflicting fields block this workflow?
decision: Prioritize data repair for a decision
grain: One evidence issue affecting a subject field and workflow in a snapshot
separate_because: Missing fields have different consequences in different workflows
merge_or_defer: Do not rank every optional missing field as an equal defect
rationale: Unknown audit and handover cases justify actionable gaps; assignment and resolution histories require collaboration data.

name: Detailed acoustic response
question: How might finishes and transmission paths affect room acoustics across frequency bands?
grain: One analysis metric for a space or path and frequency band in a scenario
separate_because: Frequency-specific results differ from a simple product rating
merge_or_defer: Defer simulation and detailed taxonomy until a specialist workflow and corpus justify them
rationale: Possible specialist value but no current acoustic scenario and insufficient boundary conditions; low priority refers only to initial scope.

name: Duct segment
question: Which duct sizes constructions and design airflows are assigned to each HVAC route?
decision: Prepare duct schedules and coordinate fabrication scope
grain: One physical duct segment with declared segment boundaries
separate_because: Section shape lining and airflow are familiar mechanical fields with distinct meanings
merge_or_defer: Keep fittings as linked occurrences when fabrication needs them; do not derive airflow from geometry
rationale: Expected mechanical schedule value; generic connectivity scenarios support links but do not establish duct lining or design-flow evidence.

name: Pipe segment
question: Which pipe sizes materials and service requirements apply to each run?
decision: Prepare pipe schedules and check service-specific requirements
grain: One physical pipe segment with declared segment boundaries
separate_because: Nominal size service medium and slope or pressure requirements differ from duct airflow fields
merge_or_defer: Use optional drainage or pressure facets where applicable; do not force every pipe to have both
rationale: Expected plumbing and mechanical value; slope and pressure remain explicitly conditional rather than inferred from generic route geometry.
